observations: Photo 0 shows a white portable air cooler with a blue top panel and black grille front. It has four caster wheels and a power cord with a 3-pin plug on the floor.
Photo 1 shows the same unit from a slightly different angle, with the same branding visible on the top. The unit appears to be in a room with tiled flooring and a window with bars in the background.
The unit has visible wear: scuffs and dirt on the front grille and body. The power cord is unplugged and lying on the floor.
No model number or serial number is visible in either photo.
The seller claims it is in 'good working condition'.

claims.claim: Portable Scanfrost Air Cooler in good working condition
claims.evidence: Photos show the unit's appearance but do not show it running or cooling. No proof of functionality is provided.
The claim is incomplete and lacks context. Efficiency cannot be assessed from photos alone.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened, works perfectly. Original receipt and warranty available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The air cooler may not be working or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the unit running with airflow and cooling effect, or a photo of the control panel and indicator lights.

risks.risk: The unit may have electrical faults or damaged wiring not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the power cord, plug, and internal wiring, or a video of the unit being plugged in and turned on.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unsafe or non-functional

risks.risk: The unit may have been damaged during transport or storage, affecting its performance or lifespan.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the base, wheels, and any signs of impact or deformation.

proof_requests: Video of the air cooler running with airflow and cooling effect.
Close-up photo of the power cord, plug, and internal wiring.
Close-up photo of the base and wheels to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
